svg.text: I'm Mossad, a .NET developer based in Egypt. I work remotely at Takamol and take on freelance projects

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Ubuntu, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through Upwork and Mostaql. My work includes new APIs, payment integrations and updates to older backends.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Ubuntu, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: At Takamol, I built the backend for Ahlena, a platform connecting families with caregivers and care homes.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Ubuntu, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Before that, I studied Computer Science at Damanhur University and ran problem-solving sessions with the ICPC community.
